meaning.en: Originally to wave flags and shout to boost morale in battle; now to cheer on or drum up support for someone, often without doing the real work.
meaning.zh: 原指作战时摇着旗子大声喊叫助威，现比喻为别人助长声势。

examples.zh: 球迷们在看台上为主队摇旗呐喊。
examples.en: The fans cheered the home team on from the stands.

examples.zh: 他只会在背后摇旗呐喊，从不亲自动手。
examples.en: He only cheers from the sidelines and never gets his hands dirty.

examples.zh: 不少媒体为这项新政策摇旗呐喊。
examples.en: Many media outlets drummed up support for the new policy.

usage.en: Predicate; often 为……摇旗呐喊. Can be mildly critical of mere cheerleading.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“为……摇旗呐喊”；有时含贬义，指只会助威不干实事。

meaning.en: Each has their own strong points.
meaning.zh: 各人都有自己的长处。

examples.zh: 这两位候选人各有所长，很难取舍。
examples.en: Both candidates have their own strengths, so it's hard to choose.

examples.zh: 团队成员各有所长，配合得很好。
examples.en: Each team member brings something different, and they work well together.

usage.en: Predicate; often paired with 各有所短.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常与“各有所短”连用。

meaning.en: The unwritten social rules and ways of dealing with people.
meaning.zh: 为人处世的道理和社会上的人情往来。

examples.zh: 他刚毕业，还不太懂人情世故。
examples.en: Fresh out of university, he doesn't yet know much about the ways of the world.

examples.zh: 她很懂人情世故，在单位人缘很好。
examples.en: She's very socially savvy and popular at work.

usage.en: Object, usually of 懂/不懂/通晓.
usage.zh: 多作宾语，常与“懂”“不懂”“通晓”搭配。

meaning.en: Paralysis of one side of the body.
meaning.zh: 身体一侧瘫痪，不能随意活动。

examples.zh: 爷爷中风后半身不遂，需要人照顾。
examples.en: After his stroke, Grandad was paralysed down one side and needs care.

examples.zh: 经过康复训练，这位半身不遂的病人能慢慢走路了。
examples.en: After rehabilitation, the partially paralysed patient can slowly walk again.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; medical term. 遂 is read suí here.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语；医学用语。“遂”在此读suí。

meaning.en: To seize on a matter as a pretext for airing one's own views or grievances.
meaning.zh: 借某个话题来表达自己的真实意图，或借机生事。

examples.zh: 他不过迟到了五分钟，老板就借题发挥，批评了他半天。
examples.en: He was just five minutes late, but the boss used it as an excuse to tear into him.

examples.zh: 别借题发挥了，有话直说。
examples.en: Stop using that as a pretext — just say what you mean.

examples.zh: 评论员借题发挥，谈起了教育问题。
examples.en: The commentator seized on the topic to talk about education.

usage.en: Predicate; often critical.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，多含贬义。

meaning.en: To issue an order in the morning and change it by evening; constantly changing policies.
meaning.zh: 早上发布的命令晚上就改了，形容政令、主张经常改变。

examples.zh: 政策朝令夕改，企业无所适从。
examples.en: With policy changing at every turn, businesses don't know what to do.

examples.zh: 管理制度不能朝令夕改。
examples.en: Management rules shouldn't be chopped and changed all the time.

story.en: Chao Cuo, memorialising on grain, complained of officials whose 'orders in the morning are changed by evening' (朝令而暮改).
story.zh: 晁错《论贵粟疏》：“急政暴赋，赋敛不时，朝令而暮改。”

usage.en: Predicate or attributive; 朝 is read zhāo.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。“朝”读zhāo。

meaning.en: To restring a musical instrument; to reform or change one's approach completely.
meaning.zh: 调换琴弦，重新安上，比喻改革制度或改变方法。

examples.zh: 这套办法行不通，必须改弦更张。
examples.en: This approach isn't working — we need a complete change of tack.

examples.zh: 公司改弦更张，转向新能源业务。
examples.en: The company changed course and moved into renewable energy.

story.en: Dong Zhongshu: when a zither is badly out of tune, its strings must be taken off and restrung before it can be played.
story.zh: 《汉书·董仲舒传》：“譬之琴瑟不调，甚者必解而更张之，乃可鼓也。”

usage.en: Predicate; formal. 更 is read gēng.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，书面语。“更”读gēng。

meaning.en: To blame heaven and other people for one's misfortunes.
meaning.zh: 抱怨天，责怪别人，形容遇到挫折一味归咎于客观。

examples.zh: 考试失利后，他总是怨天尤人。
examples.en: After failing the exam, he kept blaming everyone but himself.

examples.zh: 与其怨天尤人，不如好好反思。
examples.en: Rather than blaming the world, reflect on what went wrong.

story.en: Confucius: 'I do not resent heaven, nor do I blame others' (不怨天，不尤人).
story.zh: 《论语·宪问》：“不怨天，不尤人，下学而上达。”

usage.en: Predicate; critical.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，含贬义。

meaning.en: Every family; every household.
meaning.zh: 每家每户。

examples.zh: 春节期间，家家户户贴春联。
examples.en: At Spring Festival, every household puts up couplets.

examples.zh: 自来水已经通到了村里家家户户。
examples.en: Running water now reaches every home in the village.

usage.en: Subject or adverbial.
usage.zh: 多作主语、状语。

meaning.en: A blow to the head; a sharp warning or shock that brings someone to their senses.
meaning.zh: 迎头打一棒，比喻严重警告或突然打击，使人醒悟。

examples.zh: 这次失败给了他当头一棒。
examples.en: This failure was a real wake-up call for him.

examples.zh: 裁员的消息犹如当头一棒。
examples.en: News of the redundancies came as a heavy blow.

usage.en: Object or predicate; often 给……当头一棒.
usage.zh: 多作宾语，常说“给……当头一棒”。

meaning.en: Everyone in the room bursts out laughing.
meaning.zh: 满屋子的人同时大笑。

equivalents: the whole room burst out laughing

examples.zh: 他一句玩笑话，引得全班哄堂大笑。
examples.en: His joke made the whole class burst out laughing.

examples.zh: 演员的即兴表演让观众哄堂大笑。
examples.en: The actor's ad-lib brought the house down.

usage.en: Predicate; often 引得/惹得……哄堂大笑.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说“引得……哄堂大笑”。

meaning.en: To have descendants to carry on the family line.
meaning.zh: 生儿育女，使家族世代相传。

examples.zh: 老一辈人很看重传宗接代。
examples.en: The older generation puts great weight on carrying on the family line.

examples.zh: 如今年轻人结婚不再只是为了传宗接代。
examples.en: Young people today don't marry just to continue the family line.

usage.en: Predicate or object; often in discussions of traditional values.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、宾语，多用于谈论传统观念。

meaning.en: Perfect, without any flaw.
meaning.zh: 完善美好，没有缺点。

examples.zh: 世上没有完美无缺的人。
examples.en: Nobody in the world is perfect.

examples.zh: 这次演出完美无缺。
examples.en: The performance was flawless.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。

meaning.en: To lose one's lustre, especially by comparison; also to look downcast.
meaning.zh: 比喻相比之下大为逊色；也形容心情沮丧、神色暗淡。

examples.zh: 与她的作品相比，其他参赛作品都黯然失色。
examples.en: Next to her work, the other entries paled in comparison.

examples.zh: 听到这个消息，他黯然失色。
examples.en: His face fell when he heard the news.

usage.en: Predicate.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。

meaning.en: To save the nation from destruction and fight for its survival.
meaning.zh: 拯救国家危亡，谋求生存。

examples.zh: 近代无数仁人志士投身救亡图存的斗争。
examples.en: In modern times countless patriots joined the struggle to save the nation.

examples.zh: 这本书记录了那一代人救亡图存的历程。
examples.en: The book records that generation's fight to save their country.

usage.en: Attributive or predicate; used of modern Chinese history.
usage.zh: 多作定语、谓语，多用于中国近代史。

meaning.en: To make a show of strength to bluff or intimidate.
meaning.zh: 假装出强大的声势，借以吓人。

equivalents: put on a show of strength

examples.zh: 对方只是虚张声势，不必害怕。
examples.en: They're only bluffing — there's no need to be afraid.

examples.zh: 他在谈判中虚张声势，其实底气不足。
examples.en: He blustered in the negotiations, but he had little to back it up.

usage.en: Predicate.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。

meaning.en: To parade ostentatiously through the streets; to show off in public.
meaning.zh: 在公共场合大摇大摆地显示自己，引人注意。

examples.zh: 他开着跑车在街上招摇过市。
examples.en: He paraded around town in his sports car.

examples.zh: 明星戴着墨镜招摇过市，生怕别人认不出来。
examples.en: The star swanned about in sunglasses, as if afraid nobody would recognise him.

usage.en: Predicate; critical.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，含贬义。

meaning.en: Casual and careless about details.
meaning.zh: 形容做事马虎，不细心。

examples.zh: 他做事大而化之，经常丢三落四。
examples.en: He's slapdash and always leaving things behind.

examples.zh: 财务工作可不能大而化之。
examples.en: You can't be casual about financial work.

usage.en: Predicate or adverbial; modern sense is mildly critical (originally Mencius, 'great and transforming' = sagely).
usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语；今义略含贬义（原出《孟子》“大而化之之谓圣”，义不同）。

meaning.en: Beyond repair or control; hopelessly bad.
meaning.zh: 形容事情败坏到无法挽救的地步。

examples.zh: 问题拖得太久，局面已经不可收拾。
examples.en: The problem dragged on so long that things got out of hand.

examples.zh: 他一开口就一发不可收拾，讲了两个小时。
examples.en: Once he started he couldn't stop and talked for two hours.

usage.en: Predicate or complement; also 一发不可收拾 'unstoppable once started'.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、补语；也说“一发不可收拾”。

meaning.en: With no one to depend on.
meaning.zh: 没有可以依靠的人。

equivalents: with no one to turn to

examples.zh: 老人无依无靠，靠邻居照顾。
examples.en: The old man has no one and relies on his neighbours.

examples.zh: 她从小无依无靠，靠自己打拼。
examples.en: With no one to depend on since childhood, she made her own way.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。

meaning.en: The age of sixty (one full cycle of the sixty-year calendar).
meaning.zh: 指人六十岁。

examples.zh: 他已到花甲之年，依然坚持工作。
examples.en: He's reached sixty and is still working.

examples.zh: 年过花甲之年的她开始学钢琴。
examples.en: Past sixty, she has started learning the piano.

usage.en: Object or attributive; formal.
usage.zh: 多作宾语、定语，书面语。

meaning.en: A single wrong thought or decision, often with serious consequences.
meaning.zh: 一个念头的差错，常造成严重后果。

examples.zh: 他因一念之差走上了犯罪道路。
examples.en: A moment's wrong decision led him into crime.

examples.zh: 成败往往就在一念之差。
examples.en: Success or failure often comes down to a single decision.

usage.en: Object or subject; often 因一念之差.
usage.zh: 多作宾语、主语，常说“因一念之差”。

meaning.en: To show oneself in public (originally said disapprovingly of women).
meaning.zh: 指公开露面，旧时多指妇女出现在公共场合。

examples.zh: 她性格内向，不喜欢抛头露面。
examples.en: She's introverted and doesn't like being in the public eye.

examples.zh: 为了推销产品，老板不得不亲自抛头露面。
examples.en: To sell the product, the boss had to show his face in person.

usage.en: Predicate; 露 is read lù here.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。“露”读lù。

meaning.en: To beat the drum signalling the end of a court session; to back out of something halfway.
meaning.zh: 旧时官员退堂时击鼓，比喻中途退缩。

examples.zh: 一听说要加班，他就打起了退堂鼓。
examples.en: As soon as he heard about the overtime, he got cold feet.

examples.zh: 遇到一点困难就打退堂鼓可不行。
examples.en: You can't back out at the first sign of trouble.

usage.en: Predicate; can be split: 打起了退堂鼓.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，可拆开用，如“打起了退堂鼓”。
